listing.name: MoreVanillaBounties
listing.summary: Adds More Vanilla bounties (3x more min and max) and More Vanilla bounties (Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounties)
listing.aiSummary: Increases vanilla bounty limits and adds Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounty types.

description: Increases vanilla bounty limits and adds Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounty types. Includes functional scaling and 30 day duration. Adds lunasettings sliders requiring lunalib.
